SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   D. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)

8. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   B. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   D. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   A. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
